findings.question: Q4
findings.title: Twice-interrupted pre-capture handing still loses executed spend and permits old authorization redispatch after live-map checkpoint replacement
findings.smallest_reproduction: B/probe.py run("rollback", False, 2): create battery desk with live owner dict accounts; save initial solver ledger; gateway.dispatch(admitted) settles run.1; interrupt _retain_handing on native capture and recovery; replace live dict ledger with saved checkpoint; gateway.dispatch(original admitted). B/native.py additionally reproduces without monkeypatching production methods by invoking reader.pinned at recursion depths 994 and 995.
findings.actual_result: Deterministic probe: pending=1 raw handing, unread=0; old_refused=false, calls reaches 2 on original admitted and 3 after separately rebuilding/admitting fresh world. Native probe depths 994/995: RecursionError; pending raw tuple; unread empty; redispatch_refused=false; calls=2; seal remains None.
findings.expected_result: The previously handed spend must prevent original action redispatch after restore; incomplete capture must not become authoritative equality. Honest interruption must remain recoverable without permanent seal solely from resource failure.
findings.trust_scope: Within documented in-process boundary: native probe uses genuine BudgetLedger, public settle/from_dict and replacement in execution-owner map, genuine RecursionError. No private execution-side mutation/introspection required for the failure. Q7 remains NO in this lens because the dispatched object was admitted, with Q4 currentness incorrectly recovering after information loss.
findings.proposed_correction: An owner-lifetime/publication contract is a concrete unresolved boundary, not proof that every remedy is impossible. Keeping the handed dict contents stable until comparison acknowledgement (or publishing a detached handing) preserves this case. B control with fresh dict mapping refuses even after both capture interrupts. Moving/retrying capture again only narrows the interruption window; permanently retiring honest readers or blindly accepting a raw-map recovery violates one of the required invariants. Select and implement stable owner publication/acknowledgement or equivalent recovery-source semantics; local reader normalization does not recover content already erased from the sole raw reference.
findings.classification_note: Existing OPEN family independently reproduced, not a newly discovered family and not a BLOCKER prohibited-unadmitted-action claim.

repair_assessment.owner_json_parity: Bounded controls and actual gateway probe support repair: numeric-key retained ledger is equivalent to its owner JSON checkpoint; original stale authorization refuses, a newly projected current proposal dispatches; real rollback and rewrite still refuse. R16/R17 32 controls passed including experiment parity and invalid serializer refusal. No new semantic defect identified in changed helper.
repair_assessment.lifecycle: Live-mapping replacement fails with two interrupts; detached mapping replacement succeeds under otherwise same deterministic trace. Detached publication is evidence of a viable bounded remedy, not proof of arbitrary owner mutation safety or all-interruption robustness.
